tagline: Car-free icon — every arrival is a boat arrival.
summary: Koh Phi Phi is a wholly car-free archipelago where Tonsai Pier is the single gateway and all internal/inter-island movement is by water. With marquee global brand recognition (Maya Bay) and zero road competition, it is a near-pure fit for a quiet, zero-wake electric shuttle serving both gateway transfers and premium north-island resort runs.

demand_signals.detail: All visitors funnel through Tonsai Pier from Phuket, Krabi and Ao Nang — concentrated, predictable demand.
High-volume protected-area visitation where low-wake, low-emission craft align with conservation rules.

navier_fit: Very high. Car-free island removes all road-modal competition; single-gateway concentration eases pedestal siting at Tonsai; conservation-zone rules favour low-wake electric; resort runs carry premium willingness-to-pay.
competitive_landscape: Lomprayah, Tigerline, speedboat charters from Phuket/Krabi; longtails internally. All diesel; national-park noise/wake scrutiny rising — opening for electric.
seasonality: Peak: Nov-Apr. SW monsoon May-Oct raises Andaman swell and periodically closes Maya Bay; range-gate cross-corridors, keep Tonsai-Laem Tong hop year-round.
regulatory_note: Thai cabotage + Hat Noppharat Thara–Mu Ko Phi Phi National Park rules (Maya Bay access caps, low-wake favorability). Marine Department licensing; local partner-of-record advised.

sources.label: DNP — Mu Ko Phi Phi National Park

precedents.label: Car-free island transit
precedents.note: Phi Phi has no roads/cars; all mobility is marine today (diesel)

grab.super_app_fit: Grab in-app gateway-transfer + resort shuttle booking; pier handoff at Tonsai to Phuket/Krabi land legs.
grab.wedge: Be the conservation-friendly, pre-booked electric option for a car-free marquee island — a brand-aligned premium lane in Grab.
